name: Flute
description: The shaft read by its flutes: a bounded column of fine channels.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 28%; right: 28%; top: 0; bottom: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 22%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 11%, transparent 11% 22%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
